segments.text: Why is the rescue taking so long?
segments.translation: 为什么营救工作花了这么长时间？

segments.text: Six men have been trapped in a mine for seventeen hours.
segments.translation: 6个人被困在一座矿井中已有17小时了。

segments.text: If they are not brought to the surface soon they may lose their lives.
segments.translation: 如果不能尽快把他们救到地面上来，他们可能会丢掉性命。

segments.text: However, rescue operations are proving difficult.
segments.translation: 然而，营救工作证明是困难的。

segments.text: If explosives are used, vibrations will cause the roof of the mine to collapse.
segments.translation: 如果使用炸药，震动会导致矿井顶部塌陷。

segments.text: Rescue workers are therefore drilling a hole on the north side of the mine.
segments.translation: 因此，营救人员正在矿井北侧钻孔。

segments.text: They intend to bring the men up in a special capsule.
segments.translation: 他们打算用一个特殊的救生舱把人带上来。

segments.text: If there had not been a hard layer of rock beneath the soil,
segments.translation: 如果土层下面没有一层坚硬的岩石，

segments.text: they would have completed the job in a few hours.
segments.translation: 他们几个小时就能完成这项工作。

segments.text: As it is, they have been drilling for 16 hours and they still have a long way to go.
segments.translation: 事实上，他们已经钻了16个小时，但还要钻很长时间。

segments.text: Meanwhile, a microphone, which was lowered into the mine two hours ago,
segments.translation: 与此同时，两小时前放入矿井的一个麦克风

segments.text: has enabled the men to keep in touch with their closest relatives.
segments.translation: 使被困矿工能够与最亲近的亲属保持联系。

segments.text: Though they are running out of food and drink,
segments.translation: 尽管他们的食物和饮料快用完了，

segments.text: the men are cheerful and confident that they will get out soon.
segments.translation: 但矿工们情绪高涨，相信他们很快就会出来。

segments.text: They have been told that rescue operations are progressing smoothly.
segments.translation: 他们被告知救援工作进展顺利。

segments.text: If they knew how difficult it was to drill through the hard rock, they would lose heart.
segments.translation: 如果他们知道钻透坚硬的岩石有多困难，他们就会丧失信心。
